title: Commencement of Cover and Exclusion Periods, Pass and Trip Protection
content:
Every plan written under Pass and Trip Protection covers the season that opens on 2026-11-20 and closes on
2027-04-18. Within that season each plan carries its own waiting period, counted in calendar days from the day
cover begins, and its own pre-existing exclusion period, counted in whole months before the plan starts.

| Plan | Waiting period (calendar days) | Pre-existing exclusion period (months) | First day of the season covered | Last day of the season covered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 14 | 12 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 10 | 12 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 7 | 6 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 10 | 12 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 7 | 6 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 0 | 3 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |

**On the waiting period.** It runs from 14 calendar days on Season Pass Protection Basic down to nothing at
all on the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan, which carries 0 days and so is open to a claim from the
day cover begins. Season Pass Protection Plus and Collective Trip Protection Standard each carry 10 days;
Season Pass Protection Premier and Collective Trip Protection Elite each carry 7.

**On the pre-existing exclusion period.** It reaches back 12 months on Season Pass Protection Basic, Season
Pass Protection Plus and Collective Trip Protection Standard, 6 months on Season Pass Protection Premier and
Collective Trip Protection Elite, and 3 months on the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan.
